label: PF Backlog 707
title: Memory Graph & Observability: relationship linking (derived_from, contradicts, reinforces), memory audit trail, and retrieval inspection API
body:
## Problem / why
Operators cannot inspect what memories an agent accessed, why a memory was chosen, or how memories relate to each other.

## Goal & value
Build the Memory Graph and observability API providing full inspection of memory relationships, retrieval reasoning, and audit traces.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-28`
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-31`

## In scope
- Relationship graph (derived_from, supersedes, contradicts, reinforces).
- Trace inspection API returning full memory context for any run ID.
- Observability metrics for retrieval latency, cache hits, and memory volume.

## Out of scope
- Heavy external graph database clusters.

## Definition of Done
- Trace inspection API tests pass with full lineage reconstruction of sample runs.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
